title: Concept-Based Explanations to Test for False Causal Relationships Learned by Abusive Language Classifiers

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring false global sufficiency in abusive language classifiers using TCAV (Testing Concept Activation Vectors) metrics and challenge sets with templates combining gender identifiers (e.g., women, trans people) and negative emotion words.

Measuring false global sufficiency in abusive language classifiers using TCAV metrics and challenge sets with templates combining religious identifiers (e.g., Muslims) and negative emotion words.
